rule: Only directly visible image geometry was used. U is retained when a leaf, attachment pattern, or margin is not sufficiently visible. No taxon identification, label spelling, body-text feature, or morphology-text score was used to choose states.
blinding_note: The annotating runtime had already handled the raw Voynich transcription while freezing paragraph boundaries, so this is not a claim of textual blinding. No Phase67 morphology-text association statistic had been computed or inspected before this file was sealed; the annotation decisions use image geometry only.

reuse_rule: Where the same physical object had a sealed Phase66 aggregate state, that pre-existing state is reused verbatim rather than re-annotated. New Phase67 states are conservative single-pass image-only readings; uncertain cases are U.
